cards.title: Anthropic Introduces Watermarks for AI-Generated Text
cards.body: Anthropic will watermark text generated by its AI models and extend support to older models. Some users have complained on social media that the watermarking system will catch them using Claude at work or in classes.

cards.title: Amazon to Train on Twitch Streamers' Content
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content for AI training by default unless creators opt out. Twitch CPO Mike Minton acknowledged that an opt-in approach would result in minimal participation.

cards.title: Cognition Seeks $40B Valuation in Mega Round
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks to raise another major funding round at a $40 billion valuation. This comes just months after the company raised $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation.

cards.title: AI Safety Pioneers Debate Open vs. Closed Models
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed regulation and open-source access at Ai4. The experts debated how America can compete as China advances in AI development across Asia.

cards.title: Thrive Holdings Raises $2B for Enterprise AI
cards.body: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings secured $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation. Investors include SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

cards.title: Automattic's Mesh CRM App Launches on Android
cards.body: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts app and relationship manager from Automattic, is now available on Android. The app helps users manage and organize their professional relationships.

cards.title: Sandbar Bets on AI Voice-Enabled Wearable Rings
cards.body: AI notetaking hardware has exploded with credit-card devices, pendants, pins, and transcribing earbuds. Sandbar's voice-enabled ring aims to avoid the AI hardware graveyard by focusing on practical meeting capture.

cards.title: Lovable Hits $13.3B Valuation, Raises $400M
cards.body: Lovable confirmed its new $13.3 billion valuation while raising an additional $400 million in funding. The startup achieved $500 million in annualized run rate revenue in June.

cards.title: VideoVerse Acquisition Collapses Into Fraud Allegations
cards.body: A $250 million acquisition deal has unraveled with accusations of fraud and forged signatures. VideoVerse co-founder Vinayak Shrivastav faces multiple legal cases while investors await their promised shares.

cards.title: Google Announces Pixel 11, Watch 5, New Gemini Features
cards.body: Made by Google 2026 event unveiled the Pixel 11 series, Pixel Watch 5, and Pixel Tag. The announcements included numerous new Gemini AI features across Google's product ecosystem.

cards.title: Blacksmith's Valuation Jumps 10x in One Year
cards.body: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith experienced a nearly 10x valuation jump in less than a year. The company reported revenue growth of over tenfold during the same period.

cards.title: Accel Closes $550M India Fund in Weeks
cards.body: Accel's oversubscribed $550 million India fund closed quickly, just 19 months after its previous fund. The firm still has over 55% of its prior $650 million India fund available.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Desktop App for Linux
cards.body: OpenAI finally released a dedicated ChatGPT desktop application for Linux operating systems. The release expands desktop app availability beyond Windows and macOS users.

cards.title: Google's Gemini Reaches 1 Billion Users
cards.body: Gemini surged to 1 billion users with 63% utilizing the voice feature. The chatbot now generates over 150 million images daily.

cards.title: OpenAI's Brad Lightcap Departs to Start New Venture
cards.body: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI's longtime COO, is leaving the company to pursue something new. Lightcap told staff he was excited to advance the mission from a different perspective.

cards.title: River AI Raises $1.1B at Two Months Old
cards.body: General Catalyst led a $1.1 billion funding round for 2-month-old River AI founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin. The startup focuses on building personal agents with an intriguing vision.

cards.title: Anthropic Model Makes Riemann Hypothesis Progress
cards.body: An unreleased Anthropic model made unexpected progress on the Riemann hypothesis, one of math's biggest unsolved problems. While not solving the 150+ year-old problem, the results exceeded expectations.

cards.title: Spotify Labels AI-Generated Artist Personas
cards.body: Spotify introduces "AI Persona" labels for artist profiles representing AI-generated identities. Their music will be excluded from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

cards.title: Anthropic Watermarks AI-Generated Text to Track Usage
cards.body: Anthropic is implementing watermarking technology to identify text generated by its Claude models. Some users are upset that the system could flag AI usage in professional and academic settings.

cards.title: Amazon Trains on Twitch Content by Default
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content for AI training unless creators opt out. Twitch's CPO acknowledged that opt-in would result in virtually no participation.

cards.title: Cognition AI Coding Startup Eyes $40B Valuation
cards.body: The AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks to raise another mega round just months after securing $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation. The company continues rapid expansion in enterprise AI development.

cards.title: AI Safety Pioneers Debate Regulation and Competition
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed AI safety, open-source access, and global competition at the Ai4 conference. The experts weighed regulatory approaches as China advances in AI capabilities.

cards.title: OpenAI-Backed Thrive Holdings Raises $2B
cards.body: Thrive Holdings closed a $2 billion funding round at a $12 billion valuation to bring AI solutions to enterprises. Major investors include SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

cards.title: AI-Powered Voice Wearables Take Center Stage
cards.body: Stream ring-maker Sandbar believes voice is the future of AI wearables, competing with credit-card devices and transcribing earbuds. The company aims to avoid the AI hardware graveyard with a practical voice-enabled ring.

cards.title: Lovable Confirms $13.3B Valuation, Raises $400M
cards.body: The AI startup Lovable achieved $500 million in annualized run rate revenue in June. The company raised an additional $400 million in the latest funding round.

cards.title: Google's Gemini Reaches 1 Billion Users
cards.body: Google's Gemini chatbot surpassed 1 billion users, with 63% utilizing the voice feature. The platform generates over 150 million images daily.

cards.title: Blacksmith AI Code-Testing Valuation Jumps 10x
cards.body: Code-testing startup Blacksmith's valuation skyrocketed nearly tenfold in less than a year. Revenue has grown more than tenfold over the same period.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Desktop App for Linux
cards.body: OpenAI released a dedicated ChatGPT desktop application for Linux users. The move expands access to the popular AI assistant across major operating systems.

cards.title: Brad Lightcap Leaves OpenAI as COO
cards.body: OpenAI's longtime COO Brad Lightcap is departing to "start something new." Lightcap told staff he would help advance the company's mission from a different vantage point.

cards.title: River AI Raises $1.1B in Series A Funding
cards.body: River AI, founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, secured $1.1 billion in Series A funding led by General Catalyst. The startup is focused on personal AI agents.

cards.title: Anthropic Model Advances Mathematics Research
cards.body: An unreleased Anthropic model made unexpected progress on the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics' biggest unsolved problems. The AI hasn't solved it but exceeded expected performance levels.

cards.title: Spotify Labels and Excludes AI-Generated Artists
cards.body: Spotify introduced "AI Persona" labels for artist profiles representing AI-generated identities. These profiles' music is excluded from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

cards.title: Anthropic Extends Watermarking to Older AI Models
cards.body: Anthropic announced watermarking support for AI-generated text across its model lineup. The technology aims to identify and track AI-generated content.

cards.title: Scaling AI Agents Requires Trustworthy Data
cards.body: Organizations adopting agentic AI must prioritize data quality to achieve ROI. Trustworthy data is critical as companies rapidly deploy AI agents.

cards.title: AI Professors Navigate New Research Realities
cards.body: Leading AI researchers are adapting to shifting dynamics in academic AI research. The field faces new challenges in how institutions approach AI development.

cards.title: AI for Science Needs Reasoning Over Data
cards.body: Eric Schmidt and Suhas Mahesh argue that AI for scientific discovery requires reasoning capabilities, not just data processing. The field must move beyond pattern matching to solve complex problems.

cards.title: Startups Chase Next LLM Breakthrough Beyond Transformers
cards.body: Nine years after Google introduced transformers, startups are exploring the next generation of language model architectures. Innovation is shifting beyond the transformer paradigm.

cards.title: Fonts Emerge as New AI Scraper Defense
cards.body: The web's newest weapon against AI data scrapers is an unexpected one: fonts. The technique exploits how AI models process text rendering.

cards.title: Twitch Content AI Training Now Opt-Out
cards.body: Amazon has been training AI on Twitch content for years, but users can now opt out. The shift from default opt-in to opt-out responds to creator concerns.

cards.title: Booksellers Fear AI Firms Buying Rare Books
cards.body: Booksellers suspect AI companies are purchasing and destroying rare books for training data. The practice raises concerns about cultural preservation.

cards.title: Google Reveals 2026 Hardware with AI Features
cards.body: Google announced the Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, and Pixel Tag at its 2026 event. The lineup includes numerous Gemini AI enhancements.

cards.title: Gemini Becomes Google's Fastest-Growing Product
cards.body: Google's Gemini AI chatbot reached 1 billion users faster than any previous Google product. The milestone reflects rapid adoption of AI assistants.
